mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MOCK_TRADE T WHERE T.USER_ID = #{userId})::INT AS "tradeCount" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_PREDICT_VOTE V WHERE V.USER_ID = #{userId})::INT AS "predictVotes" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_NEWS_QUIZ_PLAY P WHERE P.USER_ID = #{userId})::INT AS "quizPlays" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_NEWS_QUIZ_PLAY P JOIN T_NEWS_QUIZ Q ON Q.QUIZ_DATE = P.QUIZ_DATE WHERE P.USER_ID = #{userId} AND P.SCORE = JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(Q.QUESTIONS_JSON::JSONB))::INT AS "quizPerfect" ,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(P.SCORE), 0) FROM T_NEWS_QUIZ_PLAY P WHERE P.USER_ID = #{userId})::INT AS "quizScore" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST S WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL)::INT AS "boardPosts" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST_LIKE L JOIN T_STOCK_POST S ON S.ID = L.POST_ID WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL)::INT AS "likesReceived" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_COMMENT C WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND C.DEL_DAY IS NULL)::INT AS "comments" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_AI_CHAT_LOG A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId})::INT AS "aiChats" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_BEAUTY_LOG B WHERE B.USER_ID = #{userId})::INT AS "beautyLogs" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_WATCHLIST W WHERE W.USER_ID = #{userId})::INT AS "watchCount" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_PRICE_ALERT P WHERE P.USER_ID = #{userId})::INT AS "alertCount" ,(SELECT R.TYPE_CODE FROM T_PERSONA_RESULT R WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.ID DESC LIMIT 1) AS "personaType"
SELECT CODE AS "code" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "earnedAt" FROM T_USER_BADGE WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_USER_BADGE (USER_ID, CODE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{code}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, CODE) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO T_NOTIFICATION (USER_ID, KIND, TITLE, BODY, LINK, DEDUPE_KEY) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, #{title}, #{body}, #{link}, #{dedupeKey}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, DEDUPE_KEY) WHERE DEDUPE_KEY IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO T_NOTIFICATION (USER_ID, KIND, TITLE, BODY, LINK, DEDUPE_KEY) SELECT V.USER_ID ,'PREDICT' ,#{title} ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE V.CORRECT IS NOT NULL) || '문제 중 ' || COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE V.CORRECT) || '개 맞혔어요' ,'/predict' ,'PREDICT:' || #{tradeDate} FROM T_PREDICT_VOTE V JOIN T_PREDICT_ITEM I ON I.ID = V.ITEM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.TRADE_DATE = #{tradeDate} GROUP BY V.USER_ID ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, DEDUPE_KEY) WHERE DEDUPE_KEY IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "id" ,KIND AS "kind" ,TITLE AS "title" ,BODY AS "body" ,LINK AS "link" ,(READ_YN = 'Y') AS "read" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" FROM T_NOTIFICATION WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_NOTIFICATION WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND READ_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_ATTENDANCE (USER_ID, DAY) VALUES (#{userId}, #{day}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, DAY) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT DAY FROM T_ATTENDANCE WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY DAY DESC LIMIT 400
